hack.root_cause: Flash Loan + AMM Price Manipulation (Treasury Drain)
hack.description: Nirvana Finance, which claimed its ANA token "cannot go to zero," was drained of $3.5M via a $10M Solend flash loan that inflated ANA 3x before the treasury was cashed out at the fake price — NIRV and ANA then crashed ~90%.
